Check yourself. 1. 12% headline, 5%/yr loss probability, 60% LGD. Risk-adjusted? The answer: 12 − 3 = 9%.
Check yourself. 2. Why assume conservatively? The answer: Losses cluster in stress, when many positions fail together; optimistic assumptions overstate income.
Check yourself. 3. Two positions, same risk-adjusted yield. Which gets more capital? The answer: The one with the smaller and better-understood worst case.
